variables.question: Data Request Description
variables.value:
We are developing a new Team member leasing platform replacing existing eVehicle application. 
We need to access to this API to get the eligibility slot information to determine the vehicle leasing eligibility of the team members.

variables.name: v_dar_businessJustification
variables.question: Business Justification
variables.value:
Below are the fields that our application will be pulling from this API. 

ccType,ccSubType,eligibilityId,eidEligibilityId,eligibilityDescription,eligibilitySlotStatus,orderNo,departmentnumber,ownerhexguid,vehicleForIndividual,isProxy,feeVersion, alloworder

variables.question: Data Request Description
variables.value: Requesting access to manage database tables and views related to the Paperless Approval Workflow System(PAWS). This includes the ability to review, modify, and maintain data structures and relationships required for PAWS application.

variables.name: v_dar_businessJustification
variables.question: Business Justification
variables.value:
The access is needed to analyze and resolve issues where packages from different sources and approval process.
 
The same database instance is used for Development, Staging, and Production environments. Access will be used responsibly to troubleshoot, validate, and maintain data integrity across all environments without disrupting production operations.
 
This will also help us support operational efficiency by ensuring application functioning as per business needs and packages processing on time, and data accuracy across systems.

variables.name: v_dar_businessJustification
variables.question: Business Justification
variables.value:
Need select access to customer tables on RAW and TRN for analysis to help design DNSS DNM segmentation projects (MTA)

This solution addresses the end-to-end orchestration of customer privacy and marketing preferences, specifically focusing on managing "Do Not Sell or Share" (DNSS) signals received via Toyota Integrated Privacy System (TIPS). The initiative ensures that the data lifecycle preserves the logical distinction between privacy rights and marketing opt-outs, and that external systems such as Acxiom (EMD) act on accurate, context-aware information. Key enhancements include flag-based decision logic, enriched extract processes, and options to segregate marketing suppression logic from global privacy actions.
A significant defect is currently impacting the correct handling of DSAR Right to Opt-Out of Sale or Share (RTOO/DNSS) requests. When a customer submits this request via TIPS, the event is propagated to Customer Central (CC), which subsequently notifies the Enterprise Communication Preference Center (ECPC). However, ECPC incorrectly interprets these RTOO/DNSS signals as a global marketing opt-out, modifying the customer's marketing preferences inappropriately. This results in erroneous suppression of marketing messages, even for customers who explicitly opted to receive communications.
The objective is to deliver a carefully measured and governed solution that preserves the distinction between privacy and marketing preference signals across all data pipelines. The proposed solution involves identifying and auditing the business rules used by all downstream systems (receiving RTOO/DNSS or DNM flags), ensuring that:
Privacy flags (RTOO/DNSS) are not misinterpreted as blanket marketing opt-outs.
Marketing communication opt-outs continue to respect the user's actual preference granularity (brand, category, or channel level).
Logical separation is maintained throughout the data lifecycle across all platform layers.

Requesting read-only PROD data from TBDP reference_trn_ext schema to use in validating zip geographic data used in Digital Innovations (DI). 
Acronyms:
DI = Digital Innovations. New team created under Jason Ballard / Kevin Austin / Andrew Gilleland from ToyotaRev to be a self-reliant organization with team members from business, tech, and data science. Dotted-line connected to Sales and SCaFT (Supply Chain and Fulfillment Transformation) 
SCaFT - Supply Chain and Fulfillment Transformation. TMNA's logistics and supply chain team focused on transforming the supply chain landscape using predictive and prescriptive modeling of data to ensure vehicles and parts go from manufacturing to dealers then retail sales as expeditiously as possible
ML = Machine Learning. Models/systems to learn from data, to identify patterns and make decisions with minimal TMNA team member intervention. The Data Science team of Digital Innovations are the primary creators of these models, and the Digital Innovations Reporting and Analytics provides analysis & reporting to stakeholders

Identify and kaizen any inefficiencies in existing supply chain processes

Comments/RACF definitions
Creating Groups for InfoPrint		
	Define two groups AOPADMIN & AOPGROUP	 ADDGROUP (AOPADMIN) OMVS(GID(yy))

Creating AOP Resource Profiles		
	"Define new AOP Profiles  AOP.ADMINISTRATOR 
& AOP.CONFIGURATION"	" RDEFINE PRINTSRV (AOP.ADMINISTRATOR) UACC(NONE)          
 RDEFINE PRINTSRV (AOP.CONFIGURATION) UACC(NONE)          
 SETROPTS CLASSACT(PRINTSRV) RACLIST(PRINTSRV)          
 SETROPTS RACLIST(PRINTSRV) REFRESH "
		
Groups access to new resource profile		
		" PERMIT AOP.ADMINISTRATOR CLASS(PRINTSRV) ACCESS(UPDATE) ID(AOPADMIN)          
 PERMIT AOP.CONFIGURATION CLASS(PRINTSRV) ACCESS(UPDATE) ID(AOPCONF)          
 SETROPTS RACLIST(PRINTSRV) REFRESH "
		
Connect the required userID groups to the InfoPrint server groups		
	Please connect the individual zOS sysprog userid's or for the sysprog group to these Groups 	
	To Connect to the group AOPCONF :	
	For Individual ID	
	For all zOS system programmers by using the groups	 CONNECT (U000) GROUP(AOPCONF)          
		 CONNECT (U060) GROUP(AOPCONF)          
	To Connect to the group AOPADMIN :	
	For Individual ID	
	For all zOS system programmers by using the groups	 CONNECT (U000) GROUP(AOPADMIN)          
		 CONNECT (U060) GROUP(AOPADMIN)          
		
	In Future, for Application Print team or for the sysprog, can connect the individual userID to the above group upon valid requests	
		
UserID and its OMVS definitions		
	Define the userID - AOPSTC 	" ADDUSER AOPSTC OMVS(UID(dd) HOME('/tmp') +                               
 PROGRAM('/bin/sh')) DFLTGRP(AOPADMIN) NOPASSWORD "
		
Started tasks creations		
	"Please define below STCs with the required access as
 mentioned:"	" SETROPTS GENERIC(STARTED)          
 RDEFINE STARTED AOPPROC.* STDATA(USER(AOPSTC) GROUP(AOPADMIN))          
 SETROPTS CLASSACT(STARTED) RACLIST(STARTED)          
 SETROPTS RACLIST(STARTED) REFRESH          "
	 AOPPROC --> all the below stc's	
•	AOPSTART	
•	AOPSTOP	
•	AOPDEMON	
•	AOPSTAR2	
•	AOPSTOP2	
•	AOPBATCH	
•	AOPPRINT	
•	AOPSTAT	
		
Access to Infoprint Server ISPF data sets		
		" ADDGROUP (AOP) SUPGROUP(SYS1) OWNER(SYS1)          
 ADDSD 'AOP.*' GENERIC OWNER(AOP) UACC(READ)  "

variables.name: v_dar_DataReqDescription
variables.question: Data Request Description
variables.value:
This request is to enable cross-account data access between TBDP & TDSP, and TBDP & FMP accounts.
Models running in the TDSP account require read access to specific datasets stored in the TBDP S3 buckets for processing and inference.
Additionally, Lambda functions in the FMP account need read access to the same TBDP S3 data to support downstream processing and integrations.
 
This access is required to enable immediate retrieval of the historical data dump containing scanned vehicle images and associated metadata received from the external vendor, UVEye.
 
In the interim, we request temporary access to the TBDP-PROD SFTP path (s3://tbdp-sftp-prod/sftp-uveye-inspection-dvi-tbdp-prod/uveye/) from the TDSP-MEDRUST pod (DEV/PROD) and the FMP PROD/NON-PROD AWS accounts used by the MEDRust application. Granting this access will allow the team to retrieve and analyze the historical data for modeling and analytical purposes.
In parallel, we will continue working on moving this data to the final layer for persistent storage.
 
**NOTE: This has been reviewed in DLDRB call with Sreekanth and Kumar and exception has been approved. (DLDRB #RITM2858608)
 
This request is to enable cross-account data access between TBDP, TDSP, and FMP accounts
ENV: DEV and PROD
 
###TBDP - TDSP Access:
 
Grant READ Only ACESS from TDSP-DEV  TO TBDP-PROD
Grant READ Only ACESS from TDSP-PROD TO TBDP-PROD
 
  *TBDP Source Buckets (Read Access Only)
  *S3 Paths
		-s3://tbdp-sftp-prod/sftp-uveye-inspection-dvi-tbdp-prod/uveye/
 
    *TDSP Roles (Read Access)
      - tdsp-medrust-lambda-service-role
      - tdsp-medrust-sagemaker-service-role
      - tdsp-medrust-service-role
 
###TBDP - FMP Access:
 
Grant READ Only ACESS from FMP - NON-PROD TO TBDP-PROD
Grant READ Only ACESS from FMP - PROD     TO TBDP-PROD
 
  *TBDP Source Buckets (Read Access Only)
  *S3 Paths
		-s3://tbdp-sftp-prod/sftp-uveye-inspection-dvi-tbdp-prod/uveye/
  *FMP NonProd Role (Read Access)
      - arn:aws:iam::264357007533:role/LambdaS3Role
      -     
      -  *FMP PROD Role (Read Access)
           - arn:aws:iam::147997159349:role/fmp-med-rust-prod-lambda-service-role
 
  ** Need access to view objects from these TBDP s3 locations from FMP account

variables.name: v_dar_DataReqDescription
variables.question: Data Request Description
variables.value: Requesting modify access to a production SQL database to support Project Orange cybersecurity reporting. The data will be used to store and manage enterprise device inventory records, calculate eligibility and compliance results, and maintain time‑based snapshots that support executive reporting and trend analysis. Access is required to create, update, and maintain tables and views used as the authoritative data source for governed reporting in Power BI. No privileged or administrative database access is requested, and no personal, customer, or vehicle‑generated data is included.

variables.name: v_dar_businessJustification
variables.question: Business Justification
variables.value:
The intended use of this data access is to support Project Orange cybersecurity reporting by establishing a reliable and consistent enterprise device inventory used for executive decision making. The primary business problem being addressed is the lack of a single, consistent population of devices used across security metrics, which causes metric variation and reduces confidence in trend reporting.
This solution enables accurate calculation of cybersecurity indicators such as device security management coverage, operating system hardening status, and patch compliance by applying clearly defined eligibility rules to a canonical device population. Key performance indicators include the total number of in‑scope devices, the percent of eligible devices meeting security requirements, and changes in these indicators over time.
The data is used to produce monthly snapshots that allow leadership to review trends over multiple reporting periods, understand why metrics change, and distinguish between true security improvements and population changes. These outputs directly support executive reporting and prioritization decisions related to cybersecurity posture, risk reduction, and operational focus areas. All decisions are made by leadership using human review, with the data serving as a trusted input for analysis and transparency.

variables.name: v_dar_DataReqDescription

variables.value:
The EVCS team has been using cust_master_redacted_ing_ext.customer_no_name to get customer home location. 
After working with Jayaprakash, he recommended to use the following query instead:
SELECT 
    A.CUSTOMER_ID,
    B.ADDRESS_LINE_1,
    B.ADDRESS_LINE_2,
    B.CITY,
    B.STATE_PROVINCE_CD,
    B.POSTAL_CD,
    B.COUNTRY_NM,
    B.LATITUDE,
    B.LONGITUDE,
    B.CENSUS_TRACT,
    D.VIN,
    CASE 
        WHEN C.EXPIRATION_DT IS NULL THEN 'ACTIVE_CUSTOMER'
        ELSE 'IN_ACTIVE_CUSTOMER'
    END AS CUSTOMER_STATUS
FROM 
    CUSTOMER_TRN.CUSTOMER_POSTAL_ADDRESS A,
    CUSTOMER_TRN.POSTAL_ADDRESS B,
    CUSTOMER_TRN.CUSTOMER_PRODUCT_ASSOC C,
    CUSTOMER_TRN.SERIALIZED_PRODUCT D
WHERE  
    A.POSTAL_ADDRESS_ID = B.POSTAL_ADDRESS_ID
    AND A.CUSTOMER_ID = C.CUSTOMER_ID
    AND C.SERIALIZED_PRODUCT_ID = D.SERIALIZED_PRODUCT_ID
    AND D.SERIALIZED_PRODUCT_TYPE = 'VEHICLE'
    AND A.POSTAL_ADDRESS_ROLE = 'MAIL'
    AND C.CUSTOMER_PRODUCT_ROLE = 'OWNER';

variables.question: Data Request Description
variables.value: All sales from this company, TMEX, are required to comply with the SAT CFDI 4.0 electronic invoicing requirements outlined above. As such, this entity will need to send invoice information to a PAC (Pegaso) to initiate the process to generate the UUID. In Mexico, electronic documents must be issued according to Articles 29, 29-A and 29-B of the Federation Fiscal Code (CFF: Código Fiscal de la Federación) as of December 1, 2017. Electronic documents are defined in the “Annex 20” of the law.

variables.name: v_dar_businessJustification
variables.question: Business Justification
variables.value: The objective of SAT is to match the payment amount and banking data with the previously generated digital invoices, and thus corresponding invoice UUIDs. SAT intends Mexican entities to submit this report each time funds are received on bank accounts.  Mexican entities that fail to submit the reports, will be liable to several fines and ultimately their invoices will become invalid. This API call is to report the reversal of billing data from SAP to SAT(Similar to IRS in US)

variables.question: Business Justification
variables.value: Predictive Modeling: Establish relationship between our incentive programs and their impact on series and regional sales. To meticulously analyze how various incentive strategies contribute to our sales rundown, ensuring that all outcomes align with our sales forecasts and targets. Scenario Analysis: Develop prediction system that can simulate sales outcomes across different incentive combinations for all product series and regions. User-Centric Simulator Interface: A user-friendly simulator interface in tableau which will empower end-users to experiment with various incentive types. They will be able to dynamically create scenarios, assessing the variance in forecasted sales against the DSM rundown, which is crucial to maintain at zero or positive.

variables.name: v_dar_DataReqDescription
variables.question: Data Request Description
variables.value:
Request: Read-only access to all SAP tables (including future/other tables) used or potentially used in the Battery USMCA RVC datasets and the associated usage report—in Production.

Why “all tables”:
The USMCA Battery RVC calculation and the usage report are a cross-domain composition of SAP data (material master, BOM, costing, procurement, inventory/valuation, vendor/plant, classification, supplier info, and custom tables). To perform end-to-end testing and lead validation, I must be able to trace and reconcile from KPIs back to row-level sources without gaps—even when a new or previously unused table is introduced by configuration changes or data model updates.

variables.name: v_dar_businessJustification
variables.question: Business Justification
variables.value:
Purpose: Enable end-to-end testing and validation of the Battery USMCA Regional Value Content (RVC) datasets and the associated usage report, using authoritative SAP production data. This access allows me to trace KPIs back to source rows across Material → BOM → Costing → Procurement → Inventory/Supplier Info → Classification (incl. custom tables) and confirm accuracy before regulatory use. 

Problem Statement: USMCA Battery RVC calculations aggregate data from multiple SAP domains. Example snapshots frequently miss edge cases and newly introduced tables. Without comprehensive, read-only visibility to the full SAP table set in Production, we cannot: verify mappings (Pack → Module → Cell) and volumes/costs, reconcile KPI outputs to SAP sources, or quickly diagnose defects when additional tables are used. This creates risk of inaccurate KPIs, audit findings, and compliance delays. 

Scope of Access: Read-only access to all SAP tables that feed—or may newly feed—the Battery USMCA RVC datasets and usage report, to support testing, reconciliation, lineage verification, and defect triage. access is user-scoped, time-bound, and used solely for compliance validation activities.

variables.name: v_dar_DataReqDescription
variables.question: Data Request Description
variables.value:
GPS (Global Planning System) is a new cloud-native demand planning application built on AWS for Toyota Motor North America. It manages vehicle sales objectives and dealer-level wholesale/retail targets across Toyota and Lexus brands.

GPS is the strategic replacement for SPPS (Sales and Production Planning System), a legacy on-premise application. As part of the SPPS decommission, GPS must take over all data feeds that SPPS currently owns — including the Lexus sales objectives feed to NVS (National Vehicle System) via the EIG middleware.

The NVS integration is on the critical path for SPPS cutover. Dealer-level Lexus sales objectives must continue to flow to NVS without interruption during migration. This request enables the GPS AWS Lambda to securely insert Lexus sales objectives into the EIG ProcessSalesObjectives API using OAuth 2.0 authentication.

variables.name: v_dar_businessJustification
variables.question: Business Justification
variables.value:
GPS calculates monthly Lexus vehicle sales objectives (retail and wholesale targets) by dealer area and model group. These objectives must be transmitted to NVS (National Vehicle System) via the EIG ProcessSalesObjectives API as part of the SPPS decommission — GPS is taking over this feed from the legacy SPPS system.

Without this integration, objectives must be entered manually, causing delays and errors in the monthly sales planning cycle. Automating this ensures timely, accurate delivery of dealer targets and is on the critical path for SPPS cutover. GPS inserts sales objective records only — no data is read or retrieved. Data is vehicle sales planning data, non-personal and non-sensitive.

Ingestion will be using QLIK and data will be persisted only in stg layer.

variables.value:
To support regulatory request . 

Get VIN list for all customers from the states Colorado, conneticut, virgina and Utah.


Query : Use filters for state_province_cd and also if required use date fields (customer_product_assoc.effective_dt - date when the customer got associated with the vehicle, customer_product_assoc.expiration_dt is not null will provide all active customers) 

select d.state_province_cd, vin from  cust_master_trn_ext.customer_postal_address a 
left join cust_master_trn_ext.customer_product_assoc b on a.customer_id=b.customer_id
left join vehicle_master_trn_ext.serialized_product c on b.serialized_product_id=c.serialized_product_id
left join cust_master_trn_ext.postal_address d on a.postal_address_id=d.postal_address_id
where c.SERIALIZED_PRODUCT_TYPE = 'VEHICLE' -- to include only association of customer with vehicle
--and b.customer_product_role in ('OWNER','DRIVER') --- include only owner and driver roles of a customer. To be used if needed
and b.expiration_dt IS NULL --- to include only Active customers
--and b.effective_dt >='enter a date' ---- To be used if needed for date filters
group by d.state_province_cd, vin;

The goal of gaining access to this data would be to mitigate these issues and cut down overall development hours

variables.name: v_dar_DataReqDescription
variables.question: Data Request Description
variables.value:
The EVCS team has been using cust_master_redacted_ing_ext.customer_no_name to get customer home location. 
After working with Jayaprakash, he recommended to use the following query instead:
SELECT 
    A.CUSTOMER_ID,
    B.ADDRESS_LINE_1,
    B.ADDRESS_LINE_2,
    B.CITY,
    B.STATE_PROVINCE_CD,
    B.POSTAL_CD,
    B.COUNTRY_NM,
    B.LATITUDE,
    B.LONGITUDE,
    B.CENSUS_TRACT,
    D.VIN,
    CASE 
        WHEN C.EXPIRATION_DT IS NULL THEN 'ACTIVE_CUSTOMER'
        ELSE 'IN_ACTIVE_CUSTOMER'
    END AS CUSTOMER_STATUS
FROM 
    CUSTOMER_TRN.CUSTOMER_POSTAL_ADDRESS A,
    CUSTOMER_TRN.POSTAL_ADDRESS B,
    CUSTOMER_TRN.CUSTOMER_PRODUCT_ASSOC C,
    CUSTOMER_TRN.SERIALIZED_PRODUCT D
WHERE  
    A.POSTAL_ADDRESS_ID = B.POSTAL_ADDRESS_ID
    AND A.CUSTOMER_ID = C.CUSTOMER_ID
    AND C.SERIALIZED_PRODUCT_ID = D.SERIALIZED_PRODUCT_ID
    AND D.SERIALIZED_PRODUCT_TYPE = 'VEHICLE'
    AND A.POSTAL_ADDRESS_ROLE = 'MAIL'
    AND C.CUSTOMER_PRODUCT_ROLE = 'OWNER';

variables.name: v_dar_businessJustification
variables.question: Business Justification
variables.value: FPSL (Financial Product Sub-ledger is SAP's solution to manage finance products as separate sub-ledger). This solution will account for a business event at the most granular level with no entry netting (or aggregation) to increase the transparency of general ledger entries. Servicing systems like Shaw calculates and store amounts such as Principal, Interest Receivable, Dealer Reserves, Interest Income. As part of this project, FPSL will be customized to use the amounts from Shaw via EDP 2.0 (as contract level business events) to derive Accounting Debits/Credits for the correct SAP code block. We need to load these files daily in EDP 2.0 S3 Bucket for the above mentioned project and using the data attributes we calculate the General Ledger(G/L) amount and compare against the prod GL amount . We are access the mainframe file to create readable layout via Informatica Powerexchange data mapping , hence need read access to DTLTST ID , which is used to establish connection between mainframe and informatica powerexchange to access the file and do data mapping

variables.name: v_dar_businessJustification
variables.question: Business Justification
variables.value: cross-check data in ESL and plant-side andon network are consistent. Extended Justification : Essentially, I have been tasked with programming the PLC's on the line to send a record every time a part comes off of a machining asset.  Currently, we have a group leader manually entering this data in for each machining line for each shift for each day.  There are problems with this: the group leader often enters information before the line is finished running or starts the count after the first part has been machined.  As such, the current way of counting is inconsistent.  Some records being sent from the PLC's are getting "lost in the pipes", where we recorded a part coming off of the line but we don't see a corresponding record on the QDMS web page.  As such, I am requesting access to the QDMS parts count database to be able to track down where we're dropping requests to benchmark the accuracy of the cogs in the reporting process, namely Kepware and SQL.

variables.name: v_dar_DataReqDescription
variables.question: Data Request Description
variables.value:
Requesting read-only PROD data from PostgreSQL toms_prod schema to use in data science modeling for Digital Innovations (DI). 
Acronyms:
DI = Digital Innovations. New team created under Jason Ballard / Kevin Austin / Andrew Gilleland from ToyotaRev to be a self-reliant organization with team members from business, tech, and data science. Dotted-line connected to Sales and SCaFT (Supply Chain and Fulfillment Transformation) 
SCaFT - Supply Chain and Fulfillment Transformation. TMNA's logistics and supply chain team focused on transforming the supply chain landscape using predictive and prescriptive modeling of data to ensure vehicles and parts go from manufacturing to dealers then retail sales as expeditiously as possible
ML = Machine Learning. Models/systems to learn from data, to identify patterns and make decisions with minimal TMNA team member intervention. The Data Science team of Digital Innovations are the primary creators of these models, and the Digital Innovations Reporting and Analytics provides analysis & reporting to stakeholders

variables.name: v_dar_businessJustification
variables.question: Business Justification
variables.value:
Digital Innovations data scientist requesting access to toms_prod schema for training ML data models.
Plans for data use:
Create machine learning data models to transform existing supply chain processes and challenges. Some projects in-flight include: 
optimize production and placement of TMNA vehicles, parts and accessories
predict dealer (and retail customer) needs
identify factory and field installed options and accessories by geographic region 
predict any supply chain needs for inventory, preemptively avoid any bottlenecks 
Goals
Reduce ancillary costs created by unnecessary dwell times in TMNA supply chain
Provide a seamless and efficient experience for our dealers (and ultimately our retail customers) by optimizing where we allocate our resources
Identify and kaizen any inefficiencies in existing supply chain processes

variables.name: v_dar_businessJustification
variables.question: Business Justification
variables.value:
To link TPCO purchase records with customer and vehicle identifiers to analyze dealership service visits. KPIs include purchase-to-service linkage and service return rate.

The Enterprise AI (EAI) team at Toyota Motor North America (TMNA) is developing a TPCO AI Agent to help business users understand customer journeys following parts purchases.
The intended use of the requested customer and vehicle linkage data is to connect TPCO parts purchase records with the corresponding vehicle and NSH service history records. This linkage will enable business users to determine whether parts purchasers subsequently visited Toyota dealerships for service and analyze post-purchase service behavior.
Key performance indicators (KPIs) include:
Percentage of parts purchasers with a subsequent dealership service visit.
Time between purchase and subsequent service visits.
Ability to link eligible purchase records with corresponding vehicle and service history records for business analysis.

variables.name: v_dar_businessJustification
variables.question: Business Justification
variables.value:
•	We have a mainframe application, FISS. 
•	FISS administers Dealer Personnel contest incentives, verifies eligibility to receive incentive funds, and generates payment information for Dealer Personnel. Then it coordinates payment to them through a payment processor, and requests payment processor payment/funding from PeopleSoft (sends it to SAP).
•	FISS integrates with PeopleSoft. 
•	We have a 5-year Tech Dept project to sunset PeopleSoft and save Toyota millions of dollars. 
•	Because FISS integrates with PS, we had two choices: 
o	Rewrite mainframe-based FISS integrations and continue to extend tech debt.
o	For about the same cost, modernize FISS into an AWS-cloud system (named DPP) allowing substantial improvements to how we process dealer personnel incentive payments. We chose this option.

variables.name: v_dar_businessJustification
variables.question: Business Justification
variables.value: FPSL (Financial Product Sub-ledger is SAP's solution to manage finance products as separate sub-ledger). This solution will account for a business event at the most granular level with no entry netting (or aggregation) to increase the transparency of general ledger entries. Servicing systems like Shaw calculates and store amounts such as Principal, Interest Receivable, Dealer Reserves, Interest Income. As part of this project, FPSL will be customized to use the amounts from Shaw via EDP 2.0 (as contract level business events) to derive Accounting Debits/Credits for the correct SAP code block. We need to load these files daily in EDP 2.0 S3 Bucket for the above mentioned project and using the data attributes we calculate the General Ledger(G/L) amount and compare against the prod GL amount . We are access the mainframe file to create readable layout via Informatica Powerexchange data mapping , hence need read access to DTLTST ID , which is used to establish connection between mainframe and informatica powerexchange to access the file and do data mapping

variables.name: v_dar_businessJustification
variables.question: Business Justification
variables.value: FPSL (Financial Product Sub-ledger is SAP's solution to manage finance products as separate sub-ledger). This solution will account for a business event at the most granular level with no entry netting (or aggregation) to increase the transparency of general ledger entries. Servicing systems like Shaw calculates and store amounts such as Principal, Interest Receivable, Dealer Reserves, Interest Income. As part of this project, FPSL will be customized to use the amounts from Shaw via EDP 2.0 (as contract level business events) to derive Accounting Debits/Credits for the correct SAP code block. We need to load these files daily in EDP 2.0 S3 Bucket for the above mentioned project and using the data attributes we calculate the General Ledger(G/L) amount and compare against the prod GL amount . We are access the mainframe file  to create readable layout via Informatica Powerexchange data mapping  , hence need read access to T030HXT  ID , which is used to establish connection between mainframe and informatica powerexchange  to access the file and do data mapping

variables.value:

1. Global Assembly Line Control (GALC) production data is critical to many downstream systems.
2. The Actual Results Database (ARDB) is a data source of GALC production results for downstream systems.
3. ARDB ingests GALC data near real time
4. GALC is getting ready to undergo a major upgrade (G4). (TMMK - July, 2023. TMMMS/TMMTX - December, 2023, remaining NAMCs in 2024)

ARDB will require an application id to access the GALC G4 database in production at TMMTX in order to maintain all of the interface points with GALC after the upgrade to G4.

variables.question: Data Request Description
variables.value: I am requesting read-only access to the database that provides data to the TrakSYS application. This includes the data used for daily quality confirmation activities, environmental monitoring, process condition monitoring, and historical process data. Access is requested for analysis and reporting purposes only. No write, modification, or administrative access is required.

variables.name: v_dar_businessJustification
variables.question: Business Justification
variables.value: I am a Production Engineer II in Paint 1 at Toyota Motor Manufacturing Kentucky. I am requesting access to this data so that I can develop custom Power BI dashboards and reports to improve data visualization, trend analysis, and process monitoring. Currently, reviewing certain datasets through the TrakSYS interface can be time-consuming and does not provide the flexibility needed to efficiently analyze trends and identify process concerns. Access to the underlying data would allow me to monitor key performance indicators such as environmental conditions, process operating parameters, quality confirmation results, and historical process performance more effectively. This would support faster identification of abnormalities, improved troubleshooting, and more informed engineering decisions while reducing the time required for manual data review.

Requesting read-only TBDP PROD data from PostgreSQL toms_prod schema. 
Acronyms:
DI = Digital Innovations. New team created under Jason Ballard / Kevin Austin / Andrew Gilleland from ToyotaRev to be a self-reliant organization with team members from business, tech, and data science. Dotted-line connected to Sales and SCaFT (Supply Chain and Fulfillment Transformation) 
SCaFT - Supply Chain and Fulfillment Transformation. TMNA's logistics and supply chain team focused on transforming the supply chain landscape using predictive and prescriptive modeling of data to ensure vehicles and parts go from manufacturing to dealers then retail sales as expeditiously as possible
ML = Machine Learning. Models/systems to learn from data, to identify patterns and make decisions with minimal TMNA team member intervention. The Data Science team of Digital Innovations are the primary creators of these models, and the Digital Innovations Reporting and Analytics provides analysis & reporting to stakeholders

variables.name: v_dar_businessJustification
variables.question: Business Justification
variables.value:
Digital Innovations (DI) Reporting and Analytics (R&A) requesting access to data in toms_prod schema of PostgreSQL  to assist DI data science team with querying and analysis used in data science modeling. 
Plans for data use:
Create machine learning data models to transform existing supply chain processes and challenges. Some projects in-flight include: 
optimize production and placement of TMNA vehicles, parts and accessories
predict dealer (and retail customer) needs
identify factory and field installed options and accessories by geographic region 
predict any supply chain needs for inventory, preemptively avoid any bottlenecks 
Goals
Reduce ancillary costs created by unnecessary dwell times in TMNA supply chain
Provide a seamless and efficient experience for our dealers (and ultimately our retail customers) by optimizing where we allocate our resources
Identify and kaizen any inefficiencies in existing supply chain processes

Having the ability to compare the vendor's voltage of a specific battery to the voltage at the time the vehicle containing the battery just before buy-off, and then combine the telematics data to capture the battery voltage information through battery lifecycle. variables.name: v_dar_businessJustification
variables.question: Business Justification
variables.value:
To link TPCO purchase records with customer and vehicle identifiers to analyze subsequent dealership service visits. KPIs include purchase-to-service linkage and service return rate.

The Enterprise AI (EAI) team at Toyota Motor North America (TMNA) is developing a TPCO AI Agent to help business users analyze the relationship between parts purchases and subsequent Toyota dealership service visits.
The intended use of the requested Repair Order (RO) and service history data is to determine whether customers who purchased specific parts subsequently returned to a dealership for service, measure the time between purchase and service visits, and evaluate whether promotional purchases lead to downstream service engagement.
Key performance indicators (KPIs) include:
Percentage of parts purchasers with a subsequent dealership service visit.
Time elapsed between parts purchase and the next service visit.
Number and rate of observed service returns following a purchase or promotion.
The data will support customer journey analysis, promotion effectiveness measurement, business reporting, and data-driven decision-making through the TPCO AI Agent. VIN will be used only as needed to link vehicle service records with relevant purchase data. Only the minimum necessary data will be requested.

Purpose
The primary goal is to align the Data Science POD with the correct project umbrella, ensuring that the analytics work is directly tied to business objectives. Improved Governance and Compliance: Proper alignment enhances adherence to governance frameworks and compliance protocols, especially for data security and regulatory requirements.
Scalability and Flexibility: The migration allows for better scalability in handling future data requirements and flexibility in expanding the data science projects.
Enhanced Collaboration: Grouping the POD under the right product umbrella fosters collaboration across teams, reducing miscommunication and inefficiencies.
KPIs:
Cost Tracking: Measure the ability to track costs under the appropriate product/project bucket.
Cross-Team Collaboration Efficiency: Monitor the reduction in communication bottlenecks or misalignments across teams.
Scalability: Track the increase in data processing capacity or the number of models managed after the migration.

variables.name: v_dar_businessJustification

variables.value:
Recently moved from Inventory Planning Manager in SPO and was requested to join Supply Chain Strategy - leveraging and pulling data from Service Parts data tables to inform executives... projects currently utilizing NDW include Retail Inventory Mgmt Project, Part Center of the Future (Study), SPO Customer Strategy...

The calendar period table is used in many queries, pairing with demand_f for customer demand, pdc/pc INV tables for historical inventory performance at our 17 buildings, Supplier forecast vs purchase report, Fill Rate (how many customer orders did we fill on time - SPO Main KPI), etc... i had access and have prebuilt queries utilizing calendar table 
Sample Query:
select 
                                    
                                    b.month_no,
                                    b.day_dt,
                                    c.part_no,
                                    f.part_description_txt,
                                    d.customer_no,
                                    d.customer_nm,
                                    e. demand_type_cd,
                                    c.source_cd,
                                    c.stocking_warehouse_cd,
                                    c.major_moving_volume_cd,
                                    c.pro_anlst_group_nm,
                                    c.part_age_cd,
                                    c.vendor_cd,
                                    c.commodity_cd,
                                    c.tpna_no_reorder_cd,
                                    f.production_begin_dt,
                                    f.model_cd,
                                    sum(a.ACTUAL_DEMAND_QTY)
                                    
                                   

                                     from 
                                     ndw_ing.demand_f a
                                    ,ndw_ing.calendar_period_d b
                                    ,ndw_ing.part_history_d c
                                    ,ndw_ing.part_current_d f
                                    ,ndw_ing.customer_d d
                                    ,ndw_ing.demand_type_d e
                                    
                                    where 1=1 

                                   and a.cal_period_id = b.cal_period_id
                                   and a.part_history_id = c.part_history_id
                                   and a.customer_id = d.customer_id
                                   and a.demand_type_id = e.demand_type_id
                                   and a.part_current_id = f.part_current_id
                                   
                                   --and b. work_day_ind = 'Y'
                                   and b. day_dt >= '01-jan-2018'
                                   and e. demand_type_cd in ('DLR','DIST','PORT')
                                   
                                   group by
                                   
                                  b.month_no,
                                   b.day_dt,
                                   c.part_no,
                                   f.part_description_txt,
                                   d.customer_no,
                                   d.customer_nm,
                                    e. demand_type_cd,
                                    c.source_cd,
                                    c.stocking_warehouse_cd,
                                    c.major_moving_volume_cd,
                                    c.pro_anlst_group_nm,
                                    c.part_age_cd,
                                    c.vendor_cd,
                                    c.commodity_cd,
                                    c.tpna_no_reorder_cd,
                                    f.production_begin_dt,
                                    f.model_cd

Access is required to verify data availability, troubleshoot data discrepancies, validate report calculations, and ensure that business reports accurately reflect the underlying incentive data before deployment.

Business Value: Enables timely delivery of accurate reporting solutions, reduces reporting defects, and improves data quality validation during the testing phase.

Key Performance Indicators (KPI):

Report accuracy and data quality validation
Reduction in reporting defects identified after deployment
Timely completion of report development and testing activities
Successful validation of report calculations and business metrics

Problem Statement: Tableau reports cannot be effectively validated or tested without direct visibility into the source data used by the reporting solution.

Decision Scenario: Access will be used to analyze source data, verify report outputs, investigate data-related issues, and confirm that business users receive accurate and reliable reporting information. Access is restricted to read-only activities within the quality assurance environment.

variables.name: v_dar_DataReqDescription
variables.question: Data Request Description
variables.value:
This request is to create a service account named svc_fivetran for the Fivetran data replication application.

The service account will be used by the application to connect to a PostgreSQL repository database and manage objects within a dedicated schema named ftrn_rep.

The application requires the ability to create, read, update, and delete tables, as well as manage metadata required for replication configuration, job execution tracking, and operational state management.

This access is limited to the repository schema only and does not include access to any business data tables.

The service account will be used only for application-level access and will not be used for any human interaction.

variables.name: v_dar_businessJustification
variables.question: Business Justification
variables.value:
The purpose of this request is to enable the Fivetran data replication platform to operate correctly by maintaining its internal repository database.

The repository database stores configuration data, job execution status, and operational metadata required for reliable and automated data replication across environments.

Without this access, the platform cannot track replication jobs, manage configurations, or ensure successful data movement between systems.

This directly supports data availability, data pipeline reliability, and operational monitoring, which are critical for downstream analytics and business reporting.

Key performance indicators supported include successful replication job execution, reduced data latency, and improved system reliability.

This access is restricted to application metadata only and does not expose or process any personally identifiable information or business-sensitive data.

The different defect, scrap and hold data dimensions needed in this report are listed in the slide 3 below. 

This report will provide two views. The first view/page will be a summarized dashboard. The second page can be a tabular view of all defect data for a part, including the relevant data fields.

variables.value:
Acronyms:
DI = Digital Innovations. New team created under Jason Ballard / Kevin Austin / Andrew Gilleland from ToyotaRev to be a self-reliant organization with team members from business, tech, and data science. Dotted-line connected to Sales and SCaFT (Supply Chain and Fulfillment Transformation) 
SCaFT - Supply Chain and Fulfillment Transformation. TMNA's logistics and supply chain team focused on transforming the supply chain landscape using predictive and prescriptive modeling of data to ensure vehicles and parts go from manufacturing to dealers then retail sales as expeditiously as possible
ML = Machine Learning. Models/systems to learn from data, to identify patterns and make decisions with minimal TMNA team member intervention. Ajinkya is part of the team that creates the ML models.

CVI is the Customer Value Insights product in SCaFT/DI. CVI creates insights about current generation vehicle offerings. Optimization of production and placement of TMNA vehicles, parts and accessories, which is all part of predicting dealer and retail customer needs by location. i.e. having the right car/accessory in the right place. If successful, CVI will help improve speed to market and reduce time/money muda that can occur from relocating and warehousing.

variables.name: v_dar_DataReqDescription
variables.question: Data Request Description
variables.value: In accordance with current tax provisions in Mexico Toyota entities must obtain electronic invoices and validation (UUID) for all sales to national and international customers in accordance with fiscal guidelines from SAT (Tax authority - Service of Administración Tributaries) CFDI 4.0 .In Mexico, taxpayers are not allowed to send electronic documents directly to the tax authorities. Documents must be sent to an approved certification provider (PAC) that validates and approves the documents and issues a UUID for each invoice, in the name of the SAT. Currently "Pegaso Tecnologia" is a Digital Invoice Provider (PAC) that has already developed the functions to generate the Payment Receipt CFDI fully compliant with SAT technical standards in Toyota. Toyota will send Invoices, Credit Memos, and Debit Memos to Pegaso for SAT approval. Should an Invoice need to be cancelled after SAT approval, Toyota will issue a credit Memo for the full amount of the original invoice with reference to that invoice's UUID and send this information to Pegaso.

variables.name: v_dar_businessJustification
variables.question: Business Justification
variables.value: All sales from this company, TMEX, are required to comply with the SAT CFDI 4.0 electronic invoicing requirements outlined above. As such, this entity will need to send invoice information to a PAC (Pegaso) to initiate the process to generate the UUID. The objective of SAT is to match the payment amount and banking data with the previously generated digital invoices, and thus corresponding invoice UUIDs. SAT intends Mexican entities to submit this report each time funds are received on bank accounts.  Mexican entities that fail to submit the reports, will be liable to several fines and ultimately their invoices will become invalid.  The API call made is to check the status of reversal or cancellation of the billing data from SAP to SAT(Similar as IRS in US)

From April Brown: Currently there are no active users in the Production DB.  This access is required for development and pre-deployment.  Privileged access should revert back to read only on 10 May 2026 unless the requestor submits for an extension prior to this date.

We have completed the development activities for the TMMTX Dejima project using development database environments as the primary data sources.

We are requesting the creation of equivalent database objects, including tables, views, and stored procedures, in the production database environment to support the final production deployment and cutover activities.

Additionally, we require privileged access to the production database environment for a limited duration of 30 days. This access is necessary to create, validate, and ensure proper functioning of all required data structures in alignment with business requirements. The access will be used strictly for deployment-related activities and will be revoked once the implementation is completed.

We also request the creation of a dedicated schema named TMMTX_DEJIMA in the production database, with appropriate access permissions. This will support structured data management, integration with Power Apps and Power BI reporting, and enable future data migration activities as required by the business.

This request is critical to ensure a smooth and timely production deployment without impacting ongoing project timelines.

Specifically, the data will be used to track and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) such as overall customer satisfaction with Sales and Service, customer satisfaction with their vehicles, customer satisfaction trends, potential survey data discrepancies, etc.

The problem statement is to identify trends, uncover inefficiencies, and validate the impact of recent initiatives to optimize processes and resource allocation. By leveraging this data, we aim to answer critical business questions such as:

What factors are driving changes in customer satisfaction?
How can we improve the customer survey program based on data insights?
Are current strategies meeting performance targets?
The insights derived will enable data-driven decisions to enhance operational effectiveness and support strategic planning.

variables.value: FPSL (Financial Product Sub-ledger is SAP's solution to manage finance products as separate sub-ledger). This solution will account for a business event at the most granular level with no entry netting (or aggregation) to increase the transparency of general ledger entries. Servicing systems like Shaw calculates and store amounts such as Principal, Interest Receivable, Dealer Reserves, Interest Income. As part of this project, FPSL will be customized to use the amounts from Shaw via EDP 2.0 (as contract level business events) to derive Accounting Debits/Credits for the correct SAP code block. We need to load these files daily in EDP 2.0 S3 Bucket for the above mentioned project and using the data attributes we calculate the General Ledger(G/L) amount and compare against the prod GL amount . In the old system, users were required to log into a web application (QIMS) to manually look up PCRs and load their status updates into excel files and ECIMS. With TECTRIS, this manual updating will no longer be necessary, as the application will fetch daily updates for PCR and ECI statuses. This improved efficiency is of great value and will significantly streamline ECI workflows. The TECTRIS project is funded and under-way.

variables.name: v_dar_DataReqDescription
variables.question: Data Request Description
variables.value:
This request is to create a service account named svc_fivetran for the Fivetran data replication application.

The service account will be used by the application to connect to a PostgreSQL repository database and manage objects within a dedicated schema named ftrn_rep.

The application requires the ability to create, read, update, and delete tables, as well as manage metadata required for replication configuration, job execution tracking, and operational state management.

This access is limited to the repository schema only and does not include access to any business data tables.

The service account will be used only for application-level access and will not be used for any human interaction.

variables.name: v_dar_businessJustification
variables.question: Business Justification
variables.value:
The purpose of this request is to enable the Fivetran data replication platform to operate correctly by maintaining its internal repository database.

The repository database stores configuration data, job execution status, and operational metadata required for reliable and automated data replication across environments.

Without this access, the platform cannot track replication jobs, manage configurations, or ensure successful data movement between systems.

This directly supports data availability, data pipeline reliability, and operational monitoring, which are critical for downstream analytics and business reporting.

Key performance indicators supported include successful replication job execution, reduced data latency, and improved system reliability.

This access is restricted to application metadata only and does not expose or process any personally identifiable information or business-sensitive data.

variables.name: v_dar_DataReqDescription
variables.question: Data Request Description
variables.value:
As part of the GEMS Citizen Development initiative, we are actively developing applications that interact with multiple data sources—including EDC, ICS, DRS, and shop-specific reporting servers—to streamline and empower frontline operations. A key component of this initiative involves a Windows Server-hosted application responsible for writing processed data into GEMS-related SQL Server databases.

Due to Power Automate’s limitations in querying MSSQL directly, we are required to use stored procedures for database interactions. These stored procedures often rely on temporary tables and require the ability to create, modify, and write to database tables during processing. Without the appropriate access, these processes fail, causing unexpected delays.

Currently, we are managing access with multiple limited-scope user accounts for each database. However, this approach has become inefficient and error-prone. My application user frequently encounters insufficient permissions—particularly when it comes to executing stored procedures or creating temp tables—which disrupts development and data integration tasks.

Given the tight timelines of the GEMS program (with only 4 weeks allocated for development per cycle), every delay has a compounding effect on our ability to deliver solutions that directly support frontline efficiency and digital transformation goals.

To ensure continuity, reduce development overhead, and meet program milestones, I am requesting the creation of a new user account, gemba_admin, with the following access to the databases listed below: Read / Write, Create Table, Execute Stored Procedures

This access will be strictly used in service of the GEMS program and managed within the governance standards in place. 
 
Please see the list of DB's below:

variables.value:
As TBMNC is a green field facility, critical productivity and efficiency reports are being developed. As TBMNC is not a regular vehicle manufacturing facility, tailored reports are required. Our project is focusing on establishing new Data Analytics footprint for the facility.

The accessed data will be used to calculate critical pay, time, and labor metrics and key performance indicators and develop a Power BI report that will be shared with the TBMNC Accounting and Financing team.

variables.name: v_dar_businessJustification

Having the ability to compare the vendor's voltage of a specific battery to the voltage at the time the vehicle containing the battery just before buy-off, and then combine the telematics data to capture the battery voltage information through battery lifecycle.  The teams will be able analyze the data to determine if there were warning signs about the health of the battery in order to start capturing defect issues before the vehicle leaves the plant and potentially create data science models to predict issues.

variables.value:
For data discovery on the TBMNC Manufacturing Operations Management (MOM) database to build a Quality Defect Dashboard.
 
The objective is to create a Defect (Non conformance) Summary Report with visualization that captures, categorizes and analyzes defects, scrap and holds occurring across different production lots, areas, shifts and time periods. This report will enable quality engineers to quickly understand defects (non conformances), scrap & hold trends in each area and plan corrective actions quickly. This report should pull data from all production areas and provide defect analysis across various dimensions. 
 
This report will provide two views. The first view/page will be a summarized dashboard. The second page can be a tabular view of all defect data for a part, including the relevant data fields.
